capabilities: Record transactions through keyboard-driven desktop or touch mobile entry forms
View monthly and annual dashboards with trend, calendar, pie, and budget charts
Filter, search, and bulk-edit transaction details across accounts, tags, and categories
Import and export transactions as CSV with field validation and migration tools
Manage accounts, budgets, savings goals, loans, recurring rules, and attachments
extras: The author warns the plugin has not undergone long-term use or exhaustive testing and directs bug reports to Bilibili or a QQ group. The advanced bookkeeping guide and project audit are available only in Chinese. API keys are stored in plugin settings and may travel with vault or settings synchronization.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and analyze personal finances, so expense tracking normally requires a separate app outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Fetch latest rates uses Frankfurter reference rates without a key and sends currency codes only.

requires.name: AI analysis endpoint (Chat Completions, Anthropic, Gemini, or local)

summary: Local bookkeeping and expense-tracking plugin that stores each transaction as a Markdown file and provides dashboards, charts, budgets, filters, and CSV import/export.
